title: Satisfaction and zero unsatisfied count
statement: For any multiset of constraints from a fixed finite-predicate constraint template and any assignment of labels to variables, every constraint in the multiset is satisfied if and only if the sum of the unsatisfied indicators, counted with multiplicity, is zero.
